description: This Java class 'EntityMapper' provides utility methods for converting between entity objects and Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) in a Spring Boot application for an online shopping system. It includes methods for mapping User, Product, Order, OrderItem, Cart, and CartItem entities to their respective DTOs and vice versa.

classes.name: EntityMapper
classes.description: A utility component class for mapping entity objects to DTOs and vice versa, facilitating data transfer between layers.

methods.name: toUserDTO
methods.description: Converts a User entity to a UserDTO object.

methods.name: toProductDTO
methods.description: Converts a Product entity to a ProductDTO object.

methods.name: toProduct
methods.description: Converts a ProductDTO to a Product entity.

methods.name: toOrderDTO
methods.description: Converts an Order entity to an OrderDTO object.

methods.name: toOrderItemDTO
methods.description: Converts an OrderItem entity to an OrderItemDTO object.

methods.name: toCartDTO
methods.description: Converts a Cart entity to a CartDTO object, including total amount calculation.

methods.name: toCartItemDTO
methods.description: Converts a CartItem entity to a CartItemDTO object.
